quote: Solving computational problems in the theory of word-representable graphs by Akgün, Gent, Kitaev, and Zantema (arXiv:1808.01215, submitted August 2018; published Journal of Integer Sequences, Vol. 22, Article 19.2.5, 2019) poses the conjecture that the crown graph H_{n,n} has the maximum representation number among all bipartite graphs on 2n vertices.
posed_by: Özgür Akgün, Ian P. Gent, Sergey Kitaev, Hans Zantema
note: The conjecture appears in Akgün et al.'s 2018 paper on solving computational problems in word-representable graphs. Recent progress on this conjecture includes a partial proof by Mozhui and Krishna (2025, arXiv:2506.01057) for the case where n is odd.
